theme_archetype: Archetype 7 (Electric & Neon) combined with Archetype 5 (Luxury). Dark theme premium. Deep obsidian/matte black base to convey luxury and institutional-grade B2B quality, highlighted with electric blue to neon green gradients to signify advanced AI and automation.

typography.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl+ lg:text-7xl font-light tracking-tighter leading-tight
typography.label: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#00F0FF]

buttons.primary_whatsapp: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#00F0FF] to-[#00FF66] text-black font-semibold rounded-full px-8 py-4 hover:scale-105 transition-transform flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,240,255,0.4)]
buttons.language_toggle: flex items-center gap-2 bg-[#121212] border border-white/10 rounded-full p-1 cursor-pointer transition-colors

cards.feature_card: relative overflow-hidden bg-[#121212] border border-white/5 rounded-2xl p-8 hover:border-[#00F0FF]/30 transition-colors group
cards.glass_panel: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-6

ui_components.icons: lucide-react with strokeWidth={1.5} for a premium, minimal look.

abstract_neural_bg.usage: Hero background with heavy black overlay (bg-black/80) to create depth without distracting from text.

premium_workshop.usage: Background for the 'Ascolta Omnius' section or final CTA, extremely darkened (opacity 10-20%).

animations.hero: Framer Motion fade-in up with stagger. Glowing pulse effect on the primary CTA.
animations.scroll: Framer Motion whileInView for sections (opacity 0 to 1, y: 20 to 0).
animations.hover: Feature cards border glow and slight lift (-translate-y-1). Icon color shifts to neon green on hover.

page_structure_and_content.language_strategy: Implement a simple React state `const [lang, setLang] = useState('it')`. Store strings in a `content` object with 'it' and 'en' keys.
page_structure_and_content.nav: Sticky header with backdrop blur. Logo on left, IT/EN toggle on right.

sections.description: Centered layout. Logo at the top. Massive impactful headline highlighting '24/7' and 'Auto Repair'. Descriptive subhead. Primary WhatsApp CTA: 'Richiedi l'attivazione per la tua officina'. Background features the abstract neural net media URL with a radial dark mask.

sections.title: Ascolta Omnius (Listen to Omnius)
sections.description: 2-3 horizontal glassmorphism blocks representing real use cases (e.g., 'Gestione Telefonata in Tempo Reale', 'Fissaggio Appuntamento Autonomo'). Include a mock 'Play' button (lucide-react Play icon) and a visual waveform placeholder. Clean, techy look.

sections.title: Funzionalità (Features)
sections.description: Bento grid layout (4-6 blocks). Topics: Gestione Vocale Avanzata, Integrazione Totale (Driver-Agnostic), Conformità Normativa UE (AI Act 2026), Disponibilità 24/7, Apprendimento Continuo, Analisi Dati Officina. Use neon-outlined geometric icons for each. Some blocks span 2 columns or 2 rows for visual tension.
Bold, minimalist section. 'Pronto a trasformare la tua officina?'. No forms, no pricing. Massive WhatsApp button for direct contact.
Minimalist. Logo, copyright, 'Privacy Policy', language toggle duplicate.

page_structure_and_content.testing: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='whatsapp-cta-hero', data-testid='lang-toggle').
